hybrid_candidate.native_frame_time_disposition: parity_or_slightly_worse_in_several_owner-native measurements; no materially better frame-time result established

regression_rule.metric: representative p95 frame time or command latency
regression_rule.exception: explicit owner approval with documented tradeoff

decision_rule: Do not make the hybrid/composed candidate the default renderer until authority/parity is preserved and owner-native measurement demonstrates a material performance improvement. CI measurement artifacts alone cannot authorize the switch.
current_blocker: The hybrid candidate remains an opt-in experiment. Authority and visual correctness are accepted and the prior pan-time tile-upload regression is fixed, but the final owner-native comparison did not establish a material frame-time improvement over PolygonMap and the candidate still carries additional video-memory cost.
